metadata.question: Between September through November 2021, did Seattle experience at least 40cm of rainfall?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Seattle, Washington (approximately 47.6°N, -122.3°W) - Date: September 1 - November 30, 2021 (3 months) - Collection: GPM (Global Precipitation Measurement) or CHIRPS for rainfall data - I'll use GPM IMERG Final Run (30-minute resolution) which provides precipitation in mm/hr 2. Masking strategy: - No cloud masking needed for precipitation data - Simply sum up all precipitation over the period - Convert from mm to cm (divide by 10) - Need to account for temporal resolution of data 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero (A/B) from Null/Error (C3): - Valid Zero: If calculation succeeds but total < 400mm (40cm), answer B - Answer A: If total >= 400mm (40cm) - C1: If no images found in collection - C2: If images exist but all pixels are masked/invalid - C3: If result is None, NaN, or unrealistic (e.g., negative or >10000mm in 3 months) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const seattle = ee.Geometry.Point([-122.3321, 47.6062]); const startDate = '2021-09-01'; const endDate = '2021-12-01'; // 2. Data Acquisition & Check // Using GPM IMERG Final - precipitation rate in mm/hr let precipCol = ee.ImageCollection('NASA/GPM_L3/IMERG_V06') .select('precipitation') .filterDate(startDate, endDate) .filterBounds(seattle); const colSize = precipCol.size().getInfo(); console.log(`GPM Images found: ${colSize}`); if (colSize === 0) { console.log("No precipitation data found for Seattle Sep-Nov 2021."); console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Sum precipitation over time // GPM provides precipitation in mm/hr at 30-min intervals // Need to multiply by 0.5 hours to get mm per image, then sum const totalPrecip = precipCol.map(function(img) { return img.multiply(0.5); // Convert mm/hr to mm per 30-min interval }).sum(); // 4. Calculate total precipitation const stats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: seattle, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const precipMm = stats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); // Check pixel count const countStats = totalPrecip.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: seattle, scale: 10000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const pixelCount = countStats.get('precipitation').getInfo(); if (pixelCount === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after processing."); console.log("C2"); return; } // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (precipMm === null || precipMm === undefined || isNaN(precipMm)) { console.log("Calculation failed - invalid result."); console.log("C3"); return; } if (precipMm < 0 || precipMm > 2000) { console.log(`Unrealistic precipitation value: ${precipMm}mm`); console.log("C3"); return; } const precipCm = precipMm / 10; console.log(`Total precipitation Sep-Nov 2021: ${precipMm.toFixed(1)}mm (${precipCm.toFixed(1)}cm)`); console.log(`Valid pixels: ${pixelCount}`); console.log(`Images processed: ${colSize}`); if (precipCm >= 40) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
